title: credential body dfx_debug
description: Plaintext body of the credential kind dfx_debug inside the record ciphertext (04-crypto.md section 4.4; ADR-102 section 2): the sign-in of a wallet with the Debug role at the DFX API - its address, the signature of the API's sign-in message and the API base URL - and the release use {wgs} (the workgroups whose sessions of the owner's tasks may query the debug endpoint with dfx.debug). One record per user.

address.description: the wallet address of the sign-in

signature.description: the signature of the API's sign-in message (secret)

api_url.description: base URL of the DFX API including the version path, https only

use.description: the workgroups whose sessions of the owner's tasks may use the sign-in (ADR-102 section 3)
